confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors rest on several 2026-dated or recent Edinburgh sources that broadly agree. Accommodation is lower confidence: sources were ranges or single listings, not averages, and July is near peak festival pricing. Cocktail is a bounded inference from bar price ranges because no dated 2026 Edinburgh cocktail average was found. Wine is from one 2026 budget guide. GBP figures were converted to USD at an assumed rate of about 1.34 USD per GBP from general knowledge, not from a searched source. The FX value came from search-result text citing RBA F11 daily values for 16 October 2026; I did not open the RBA table itself, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed. Anchors are based on Edinburgh-specific sources, with Great Britain pint averages used as a cross-check for beer.
